annotations.title: AgentGate: Check an AI agent (Concordium registry)

description:
Check whether an AI agent is registered in the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004), Active (not revoked), and Verified by Concordium (its Agent Card hash matches the on-chain metadata_hash). Accepts a badge (CIS-2 token address, e.g. Mf22soLh1NuZYFgBK8iSs, or CAIP-19 form) or a Concordium owner account address. Free tier: returns the verdict; the full record is available from the paid x402 endpoint.

[AgentGate via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as AgentGate's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: check $0.005 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

id.description: Badge (CIS-2 token address, short or CAIP-19 form) or Concordium account address

tier.description: Paid tier: check $0.005. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
